summary: On the exact rank-two singular three-hub face with nonzero null-tail coupling omega and diffuse normalized omega-bank, choose the physical complementary indefinite pair P opposite a maximal null-vector coordinate v_i. The exact Schur coefficient vanishes and the remaining physical hub slope is Gamma=(beta0-2||omega||W)/v_i. The r53 product estimate gives ||p_W||_inf<=2, hence ||p_Gamma||_inf<=|v_i|/||omega||. Averaging the physical pair logarithmic density envelope first in the remaining hub coordinate and then in Gamma, with cutoff s^2=kappa||omega||/(8|v_i|), yields ||p_Q||_inf <= 8 sqrt(|v_i|/(kappa||omega||)) + 2/sqrt(D), where D=|det P|=kappa_F v_i^2 and kappa=sigma_min(P). Same-sign rank-two singular hubs are paid by the definite-pair bound pi/sqrt(D). Combined with r53's heavy-bank four-minor receiver, every exact rank-two singular hub with omega!=0 is now density-paid. The exact omega=0 branch is a genuine global-null vector and remains separate.
partner_application: account04/B06 QFORM-FRESH-TRANSVERSE-CURVED-SECTION-v1 gives ||g_r||_inf<=4/(|lambda_*|r), hence <=256/|lambda_*| at r=1/64, on the current post-pair tail-remainder subbranch where the curved two-frame and transverse statistic occupy disjoint original-coordinate banks.
